date:journey-to-rome-begins@a8fc17.note: Text gives no year. 27:1 starts the voyage; 27:9 places it after the fast. The year depends on outside chronology.

date:paul-arrives-at-rome@da64dd.note: Text gives no year. 28:16 says he came to Rome; 28:30 gives two years there. The year depends on outside chronology.

date:paul-is-shipwrecked-by-a-storm@da64.note: Text gives no year. The wreck comes on the fourteenth night of the storm (27:27; 27:41). The year depends on outside chronology.

date:paul-s-first-roman-imprisonment@651.note: Text gives no year, only two whole years at Rome (28:30). The span 57 to 60 depends on outside chronology.

date:paul-s-journey-to-rome@7e8b91.note: Text gives no year. The journey runs from 27:1 to arrival at Rome (28:16). The span depends on outside chronology.

date:paul-stays-at-malta@da64dd.note: Text gives no year. Paul stayed three months on Malta (28:11). The year depends on outside chronology.

occurred-at:journey-to-rome-begins>italy.note: Text says they were to sail into Italy, its destination (27:1). The voyage did not begin there.

occurred-at:journey-to-rome-begins>sidon.note: Opening stop, the day after launching (27:3). The departure port is not named, so Sidon is the first stop, not the start.

occurred-at:paul-s-first-roman-imprisonm.note: Paul was kept at Rome by a soldier (28:16) and dwelt two whole years in his hired house (28:30).

occurred-at:paul-s-journey-to-rome>cilic.note: They sailed over the sea of Cilicia (27:5). The text names the sea, not a place they reached.

occurred-at:paul-s-journey-to-rome>cnidu.note: They scarce came over against Cnidus, then the wind stopped them (27:7). They did not reach the city.
